title: Spring 3 force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates F₃ = m_C·g = 30 N from equilibrium of block C.

title: Spring 1 force
description: Essential: Correctly states F₁ = 0 N because its elongation is zero.

title: Spring 2 force
description: Important: Applies force ratio or Hooke's law to find F₂ = 20 N from F₃ and given elongations.

title: Friction on A
description: Important: Uses equilibrium of block A to find f_A = F₂ = 20 N, with correct direction (left).

title: Friction on B
description: Important: Uses equilibrium of block B to find f_B = F₃ - F₂ = 10 N, with correct direction (left).

title: Direction specification
description: Optional: Explicitly states direction of frictional forces (left/right) for both blocks A and B.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows consistent use of units (N, cm/m conversion handled correctly).

title: Wrong spring force ratio
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes equal forces in all springs or misapplies Hooke's law without considering equilibrium.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Assigns wrong direction to frictional forces (e.g., right instead of left) or omits direction entirely.
